<action type="say">
I can do that. I’ll get multiple quotes from local plumbers for you.

First, I need a few details:

1) Address or at least ZIP code where the work will be done  
2) Is this:
   - Replacing an existing faucet (same locations for hot/cold and sprayer)?
   - Or adding/changing any lines or valves?
3) Do you already have the new faucet purchased? If yes, what brand/model (or basic type: pull-down, with/without sprayer, etc.)?  
4) Any complications:
   - Garbage disposal?
   - Old shutoff valves that don’t close properly?
   - Undermount sink / very tight cabinet space?
5) How soon do you need this done?
   - Emergency (today)
   - Same day / next day
   - Routine (any time in the next week or two)
6) Preferred date(s) and time window (morning/afternoon/evening)?

Once I have those, I’ll request several quotes and show you the options.
</action>
